1|# Moonshot Coding Agent
     2|
     3|独立目录，使用 Moonshot 官方 OpenAI 兼容接口。默认模型 `kimi-k3`，支持流式正文、工具调用以及多轮消息中的 `reasoning_content` 保留与回传。
     4|
     5|## 配置
     6|
     7|在本目录复制 `.env.example` 为 `.env`，填写有效的 Moonshot Key：
     8|
     9|```dotenv
    10|PROVIDER=moonshot
    11|MOONSHOT_API_KEY=你的Moonshot密钥
    12|MOONSHOT_BASE_URL=https://api.moonshot.cn/v1
    13|DEFAULT_MODEL=kimi-k3
    14|MAX_ITERATIONS=20
    15|MAX_TOKENS=8192
    16|```
    17|
    18|也支持 `KIMI_API_KEY` 和 `PROVIDER=kimi`。进程环境变量优先于本目录 `.env`。缺少 Moonshot Key 时直接报错。
    19|
    20|## 运行
    21|
    22|在 Git Bash 中执行：
    23|
    24|```bash
    25|cd /d/AI/ai-agent-book
    26|source .venv/Scripts/activate
    27|cd chapter5/coding-agent-moonshot
    28|test -f .env || cp .env.example .env
    29|python main.py --list-tools
    30|python main.py --provider moonshot --model kimi-k3 \
    31|  --prompt '读取 README.md，简要说明配置方法。只读取文件。' \
    32|  --max-iterations 6 --no-color
    33|```
    34|
    35|启动前填写 `.env` 中的密钥。依赖见 `requirements.txt`。Moonshot 请求使用温度 1，并使用 `MAX_TOKENS` 控制输出预算。
    36|
    37|工作目录决定工具读写目标。可在 `.env` 中通过 `WORKING_DIRECTORY` 指定，留空则使用启动时的当前目录。工具权限和文件检查沿用教材实现，本目录没有新增系统级隔离。

    20|    PROVIDER = os.getenv("PROVIDER", "moonshot").lower()

    35|    @classmethod
    36|    def get_provider(cls) -> str:
    37|        """Get the configured provider"""
    38|        return cls.PROVIDER
    39|
    40|    @classmethod
    41|    def get_api_key(cls, provider: str = None) -> str:
    42|        """Get API key for specified provider (or configured provider if not specified)"""
    43|        if provider is None:
    44|            provider = cls.PROVIDER
    45|
    46|        if provider in ("moonshot", "kimi"):
    47|            if not cls.MOONSHOT_API_KEY:
    48|                raise ValueError("请配置 MOONSHOT_API_KEY 或 KIMI_API_KEY")
    49|            return cls.MOONSHOT_API_KEY
    50|        elif provider == "anthropic":
    51|            if not cls.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY:
    52|                raise ValueError("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not set in .env file")
    53|            return cls.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    54|        elif provider == "openai":
    55|            if not cls.OPENAI_API_KEY:
    56|                raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY not set in .env file")
    57|            return cls.OPENAI_API_KEY

    59|            if not cls.OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
    60|                raise ValueError("OPENROUTER_API_KEY not set in .env file")
    61|            return cls.OPENROUTER_API_KEY

    63|            raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider: {provider}. Must be one of: anthropic, openai, openrouter")

    68|        if cls.PROVIDER in ("moonshot", "kimi"):
    69|            return cls.MOONSHOT_BASE_URL
    70|        if cls.PROVIDER == "openrouter":
    71|            return cls.OPENROUTER_BASE_URL

    74|    @staticmethod
    75|    def map_model_to_openrouter(model: str) -> str:
    76|        """Map a native (anthropic/openai) model id to an OpenRouter model id.
    77|
    78|        Used by the OpenRouter fallback so a user with ONLY an OPENROUTER_API_KEY
    79|        can still run a task written for a direct provider.
    80|
    81|          - already-prefixed ids (contain "/") are passed through unchanged
    82|          - claude-sonnet-* -> anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6
    83|          - claude-haiku-*  -> anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5
    84|          - claude-opus-*   -> anthropic/claude-opus-4.8
    85|          - any other claude-* -> anthropic/claude-opus-4.8
    86|          - gpt-* / o1-*    -> openai/<model>
    87|          - anything else   -> returned unchanged (best effort)
    88|        """
    89|        if "/" in model:
    90|            return model  # already an OpenRouter id
    91|        m = model.lower()
    92|        if m.startswith("claude"):
    93|            if "haiku" in m:
    94|                return "anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5"
    95|            if "sonnet" in m:
    96|                return "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6"
    97|            # opus, or any other/unknown Claude tier -> latest Opus
    98|            return "anthropic/claude-opus-4.8"
    99|        if m.startswith("gpt-") or m.startswith("o1"):
   100|            return f"openai/{model}"
   101|        return model
   102|
   103|    @classmethod
   104|    def resolve(cls) -> dict:
   105|        """Resolve the effective (provider, api_key, base_url, model).
   106|
   107|        Applies the OpenRouter universal fallback: if the requested direct
   108|        provider (anthropic/openai) has no API key configured, but an
   109|        OPENROUTER_API_KEY is available, transparently route through OpenRouter
   110|        (OpenAI-compatible SDK + prefixed model id). Default behavior is
   111|        unchanged whenever the requested provider's own key is present.
   112|
   113|        Returns a dict: {provider, api_key, base_url, model,
   114|                         requested_provider, fell_back}.
   115|        """
   116|        requested = cls.PROVIDER
   117|        model = cls.DEFAULT_MODEL
   118|
   119|        if requested in ("moonshot", "kimi"):
   120|            if not model.strip() or cls.MAX_TOKENS < 2048:
   121|                raise ValueError("请设置有效模型名称，并将 MAX_TOKENS 设置为至少 2048")
   122|            return {
   123|                "provider": "moonshot",
   124|                "api_key": cls.get_api_key(requested),
   125|                "base_url": cls.MOONSHOT_BASE_URL,
   126|                "model": model,
   127|                "requested_provider": requested,
   128|                "fell_back": False,
   129|            }
   130|
   131|        # Explicit OpenRouter selection: use as configured (no mapping).
   132|        if requested == "openrouter":
   133|            return {
   134|                "provider": "openrouter",
   135|                "api_key": cls.get_api_key("openrouter"),
   136|                "base_url": cls.OPENROUTER_BASE_URL,
   137|                "model": model,
   138|                "requested_provider": requested,
   139|                "fell_back": False,
   140|            }
   141|
   142|        if requested in ("anthropic", "openai"):
   143|            direct_key = cls.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY if requested == "anthropic" else cls.OPENAI_API_KEY
   144|            if direct_key:
   145|                # Direct provider key present -> behave exactly as before.
   146|                return {
   147|                    "provider": requested,
   148|                    "api_key": direct_key,
   149|                    "base_url": None,
   150|                    "model": model,
   151|                    "requested_provider": requested,
   152|                    "fell_back": False,
   153|                }
   154|            # No direct key -> fall back to OpenRouter if we have that key.
   155|            if cls.OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
   156|                return {
   157|                    "provider": "openrouter",
   158|                    "api_key": cls.OPENROUTER_API_KEY,
   159|                    "base_url": cls.OPENROUTER_BASE_URL,
   160|                    "model": cls.map_model_to_openrouter(model),
   161|                    "requested_provider": requested,
   162|                    "fell_back": True,
   163|                }
   164|            key_name = "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" if requested == "anthropic" else "OPENAI_API_KEY"
   165|            raise ValueError(
   166|                f"No {key_name} set and no OPENROUTER_API_KEY available for fallback. "
   167|                f"Set {key_name} for direct access, or set OPENROUTER_API_KEY to route "
   168|                f"'{requested}' models through OpenRouter."
   169|            )
   170|
   171|        raise ValueError(f"Unknown provider: {requested}. Must be one of: anthropic, openai, openrouter")
   172|
   173|    @classmethod
   174|    def validate(cls):
   175|        """Validate configuration (fallback-aware)."""

   177|        # OpenRouter fallback key is available.
   178|        resolved = cls.resolve()

   182|        # fall back to OpenRouter the model id is remapped/prefixed, so the
   183|        # native naming rules no longer apply.
   184|        if not resolved["fell_back"]:
   185|            if provider == "anthropic" and not cls.DEFAULT_MODEL.startswith("claude"):
   186|                raise ValueError(f"Model '{cls.DEFAULT_MODEL}' is not valid for Anthropic. Use a model starting with 'claude-'")
